title: Understanding Orthogonality
text: In linear algebra, two vectors are orthogonal if their dot product is zero. This means they are perpendicular to each other in the vector space.

title: Projection in OLS
text: In the context of OLS, the residual vector $$(Y-\hat{Y})$$ is orthogonal to the column space of the design matrix \mathbb{X}. This is a key property of the least squares solution.

title: Orthogonality of Residuals
text: Given that \hat{Y} is the projection of Y onto the column space of \mathbb{X}, what can we say about the vector Y-\hat{Y}?
